claims.Claim: G11-01 — `provan.seed_disposition.v1` preserves every seed proposal and its explicit confirm/reject/edit/unresolved disposition with provenance.
G11-02 — `provan.acceptance_contract.v1` is an immutable, versioned, human-disposition-backed contract and never a mutable rewrite of the Acceptance Seed.
G11-03 — `provan.candidate_freeze.v1` independently binds the Acceptance Contract to one immutable repository candidate and its supported source/artifact digests.
G11-04 — `provan.verifier_work_order.v1` declares bounded future verification requirements, target read-only policy, protected invariants and `remediation_allowed=false`.
G11-05 — `provan.verifier_capability_request.v1` represents requested, available, unavailable, unqualified and degraded capability without implying execution.
G11-06 — `provan.verification_result.v1` preserves passed, failed, not-run, tool/environment failure, inconclusive, unavailable and not-applicable states without authority escalation.
G11-07 — `provan.environment_receipt.v1` is a future environment receipt contract and does not by structural validity establish a qualified verifier environment.
G11-08 — `provan.command_receipt.v1` is a future command receipt contract and does not by structural validity establish command execution.
G11-09 — `provan.evidence_settlement.v1` deterministically separates eligible, supporting/ineligible and missing evidence for each criterion.
G11-10 — `provan.acceptance_attestation.v1` binds contract, frozen candidate, evidence settlement, capability state, recommendation, limitations and future reinspection requirements.
G11-11 — `provan.owner_decision.v1` preserves a separate accountable human decision without rewriting Provan's recommendation or evidence settlement.
G11-12 — `provan.external_change_receipt.v1` is always treated as untrusted change-claim input rather than closure evidence by itself.
G11-13 — `provan.reinspection_record.v1` immutably binds the original obligation and evidence to a later candidate and records exact closure status.
G11-14 — Every major Session 11 semantic contract is independently recomputed from serialized canonical artifacts rather than delegated to production constructors or schema validation.
G11-15 — The final Session 10 handoff, proof root, package, candidate, Brief, context, promotion and Acceptance Seed dependencies resolve and remain valid before Session 11 authority is created.
G11-16 — Every Acceptance Seed item receives an explicit disposition before an Acceptance Contract receives authority.
G11-17 — Confirm, reject, edit and unresolved dispositions remain semantically distinct and preserved.
G11-18 — An edited proposal preserves the original proposal, edited value, actor action, timestamp and provenance rather than overwriting history.
G11-19 — An unresolved seed item remains visible as unresolved and cannot silently become an established mandatory criterion.
G11-20 — Material changes to a confirmed Acceptance Contract create a new immutable contract version with lineage rather than editing the prior version.
G11-21 — Session 11 case-operator confirmation records explicit human action but does not claim Enterprise-verified identity or organisational role authority.
G11-22 — Candidate Freeze accepts only independently resolved full immutable candidate identities.
G11-23 — Candidate Freeze binds repository identity, base/head, Acceptance Contract digest and all supported candidate digests with explicit noncoverage.
G11-24 — Candidate Freeze records supported lockfile/workspace/verification-surface state without fabricating unsupported completeness.
G11-25 — Mutable, incomplete, ambiguous or contract-mismatched candidates are deterministically ineligible for freeze.
G11-26 — Candidate Freeze and all Session 11 inspection preserve target files, index, refs, objects and monitored write state and invoke no target-defined execution.
G11-27 — Verifier work orders declare requested capabilities and protected invariants but create no Session 12 verifier execution or remediation authority.
G11-28 — Session 11 capability requests honestly represent verifier execution as unavailable, unqualified or not-run when that capability is not yet qualified.
G11-29 — Verification results preserve `not_run`, `tool_failure`, `environment_failure`, `inconclusive` and `unavailable` as non-passing states.
G11-30 — A schema-valid command or environment receipt cannot by itself establish that a command ran or an environment was qualified.
G11-31 — Arbitrary imported CI/test/SARIF evidence claiming PASS does not self-elevate to execution-verified evidence.
G11-32 — Trusted imported receipts may satisfy only contract-authorized evidence requirements after independent producer, candidate, provenance and digest validation.
G11-33 — Explicit human confirmation may establish case intent/decision authority but cannot establish runtime behavior merely by assertion.
G11-34 — Model-reviewed material remains proposal/interpretation and cannot independently establish mandatory evidence settlement.
G11-35 — Evidence settlement preserves established, falsified, not-established, disputed and not-applicable states with exact eligible evidence and reason codes.
G11-36 — Missing, not-run, unavailable, tool-failed, environment-failed and inconclusive evidence cannot satisfy a mandatory criterion.
G11-37 — Future verifier/challenge fields in an Attestation remain explicitly absent, unavailable or not-run and cannot masquerade as executed evidence.
G11-38 — A contract requiring unavailable Session 12 runtime evidence cannot receive a clearance recommendation.
G11-39 — A contract requiring unavailable Session 13 challenge evidence cannot receive a clearance recommendation.

G11-40 — A criterion whose confirmed contract explicitly permits current source evidence may be established only by candidate-bound eligible source evidence and establishes no broader software-safety claim.
G11-41 — Provan recommendation is determined from confirmed contract, immutable candidate, evidence settlement, eligibility and capability state through a versioned deterministic policy.
G11-42 — Provan recommendation and accountable human decision are distinct immutable artifacts/states.
G11-43 — An owner override preserves the original Provan recommendation, rationale, evidence and limitation history.
G11-44 — Accepted risk or an owner override cannot rewrite falsified or not-established evidence into established evidence.
G11-45 — Conditions, accepted risk, expiry and required Reinspection survive canonical artifacts and every applicable rendering.
G11-46 — Session 11 produces no composite green quality/confidence score and does not represent scoped Acceptance as defect-free, safe, secure or certified software.
G11-47 — The Acceptance Record presents at most three priority blockers/conditions on its first screen while explicitly preserving the count and accessibility of all additional open items.
G11-48 — The Acceptance Record distinguishes established and not-established criteria and gives an exact closure requirement for every material open item.
G11-49 — Any Change Topology overlay reuses Session 10 canonical entity/relationship authority and cannot create new graph truth during rendering.
G11-50 — Internal and client-safe Acceptance projections preserve sensitivity boundaries and do not leak protected source/context/planning/future-challenge material.
G11-51 — An external-change receipt cannot establish closure without eligible evidence on the later immutable candidate.
G11-52 — Reinspection creates and binds a new immutable later-candidate freeze rather than mutating the original candidate or Acceptance artifacts.
G11-53 — Reinspection preserves the original contract, finding/criterion, evidence, recommendation and decision history after closure, dispute or failure.
G11-54 — Session 11 Reinspection reruns only explicitly supported deterministic/source-level closure checks and executes no repository-defined code.
G11-55 — A runtime- or challenge-dependent closure requirement remains unable-to-establish/not-run when the required Session 12/13 capability is unavailable.
G11-56 — Future sibling/challenge fields remain `not_run` or absent and do not imply challenge generation or withheld-test execution.
G11-57 — Session 11 exposes no target execution, qualified verifier sandbox, candidate-specific challenge engine, remediation or Enterprise governance capability.
G11-58 — The final Session 10 external/fallback Change Brief is promoted into Session 11 preparation and lack of authentic upstream owner authority is recorded honestly rather than fabricated.
G11-59 — One consequential Provan Session 11 change completes the full internally authorised Change Brief → contract → freeze → settlement → recommendation → decision → Acceptance Record lifecycle.
G11-60 — A controlled later immutable candidate proves exact source-level Reinspection closure, while near-fix, unrelated-change and unavailable-runtime cases do not falsely close.
G11-61 — Gate 11 real-use and dogfood evidence is generated or replayed from the final reviewed Session 11 implementation tree or its authoritative installed wheel.
G11-62 — Package `0.4.0` is bound to Session 11 as an unpublished `QUALIFIED_BOUNDED` main-tree capability and is not represented as a Community release.

G11-63 — The Session 12 handoff independently resolves every required contract, candidate, verifier-work-order/result, receipt, evidence-policy, protected-invariant, Attestation, projection, Reinspection and implementation/package/schema binding without redesigning Session 11 semantics.
G11-64 — All inherited Session 9 and Session 10 source-only safety, evidence-authority, extension, telemetry, packaging, projection and private-planning guarantees remain valid.
G11-65 — Private planning material remains absent from tracked history delta, package, controlled CI artifacts, public proofs and examples through the existing non-sensitive absence mechanism.

G11-66 — `provan.closure_requirement.v1` provides an independently addressable, versioned and typed closure contract whose required evidence, check mode, subject, predicate and limitations are deterministically enforceable and cannot be replaced by prose.
G11-67 — `provan.protected_invariant.v1` gives every protected invariant a stable identity, version, authority, source, evidence and capability binding resolvable by Session 12 work orders.

G11-68 — Every conditional criterion has a candidate-bound `active`, `inactive` or `unresolved` activation state with provenance; active criteria are mandatory and materially unresolved activation prevents clearance.

G11-69 — `not_applicable` settlement is permitted only for an explicitly non-applicable contract term or a deterministically inactive conditional criterion and can never be inferred from missing evidence.
G11-70 — A superseding Acceptance Contract always requires a new contract-bound Candidate Freeze, and artifacts from the superseded chain remain historical rather than current for the new contract.

G11-71 — `trusted_imported_receipt` authority resolves only from an inherited content-addressed Provan producer qualification or compatibility authority and cannot be bootstrapped by claims inside the imported receipt.

G11-72 — `disputed` settlement is derived only from materially conflicting independently eligible current candidate-bound evidence for the same criterion and cannot be created by owner disagreement or override.

G11-73 — Owner decisions obey the frozen recommendation compatibility table, and proceeding despite `held` or `not_eligible` preserves and prominently displays both the non-clearance recommendation and unchanged evidence settlement.

G11-74 — Automatic Reinspection requires the same canonical repository, a later distinct descendant head and the original typed closure contract; divergent, different-repository and same-head candidates are rejected.

G11-75 — The independently predeclared controlled patient proves exact typed source closure while near-fix, unrelated-descendant, divergent-lineage and unavailable runtime/challenge comparators do not falsely close.

G11-76 — Canonical state artifacts use non-content-derived UUID identities while rendered Acceptance Record projections use separate digest-derived record IDs without conflating identity and integrity.

G11-77 — Session 11 records expiry and computes an immutable chain’s current effective `active` or `expired` status without rewriting artifacts, claiming automated external revocation or presenting expired clearance as current.

G11-78 — PR-event leakage validation excludes only synthetic GitHub merge-commit metadata while continuing to reject prohibited material in real candidate history and to scan the integrated merge tree, package, artifacts and wheel.

G11-79 — `provan.acceptance_contract.v1` completely binds preparation, obligation, criteria, invariants, closure requirements, evidence, execution, challenge budget, risk, operator authority, decision, expiry, Reinspection, version and provenance semantics required by Sessions 12–13.

G11-80 — `provan.acceptance_attestation.v1` immutably binds the complete subject, Contract, Freeze, capability, context, invariant, evidence, settlement, challenge-state, recommendation, expiry, Reinspection, usage and projection surface while Owner Decision remains separate.

G11-81 — Conditional activation rules reside in the Contract, candidate-specific activation results reside in Candidate Freeze, and Evidence Settlement independently recomputes and exactly matches those results.

G11-82 — Evidence authority is derived exclusively from qualified Provan ingestion paths and validated provenance; arbitrary files cannot self-declare source, owner, model, trusted-producer or execution authority.

G11-83 — Session 11 source-only closure supports only exact regular-artifact existence, canonical JSON Pointer equality, static Python public-export inspection and typed protected-invariant resolution, with no free-form search, import or execution.
G11-84 — A human-confirmation closure requirement is satisfied only by a canonical criterion-, candidate- and requirement-bound Provan case-operator action and otherwise remains unable to establish.

G11-85 — An Acceptance Record ID is a format-independent locator derived from authoritative Attestation and optional Decision digests; every view has a separate digest and Reinspection independently validates the canonical chain rather than rendered prose.
G11-86 — Reinspection records a deterministic per-item result for every material open requirement and derives its overall status through the frozen disputed/closed/partial/unable/open precedence.
G11-87 — Reinspection evaluates all referenced protected invariants, and any unsatisfied or disputed material invariant prevents an overall `closed` result.
